elements.title: Packaging Lifecycle Diagram
elements.content: A circular lifecycle diagram for iMac showing five stages: DESIGN AND SOURCE, MAKE, PACKAGE AND SHIP, USE, and RECOVER.

elements.title: Packaging Metrics
elements.content: 100% of the packaging is fiber-based, due to our work to remove plastic in packaging. 76% recycled content in fiber packaging. 100% of the virgin wood fiber in the packaging is responsibly sourced.
